'''KF Dukagjini''' ({{langx|sq|Klubi Futbollistik Dukagjini Klinë}}) is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Klina]], [[Kosovo]]. The club compete in the top tier of football in Kosovo the [[Football Superleague of Kosovo|Kosovo Superleague]]."}}
